purpose.summary: Reconstruct the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0016 target on a fresh public runner and execute its bounded passive mainnet-prefix smoke.
scope: Fresh-clone and build the exact Bitcoin Static baseline and signed ERGON-CHANGE-0016 candidate in distinct roots under the existing locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 environment.
Verify the public root, integration parent and technical candidate against their exact commits, trees and ErgonSurfer SSH signature identity.
Run the immutable ERGON-CHANGE-0016 passive mainnet smoke and validate its checkpoint, topology, cleanup, privacy and evidence-ceiling fields.
Emit exactly one sanitized smoke report and one source-to-binary build receipt for later independent review.
exclusions: No node, consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, mainnet-parameter, cockpit, roadmap, container or dependency change.
No modification of the accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0016 technical target, runner, checkpoint, bounds or network topology.
No raw child output, raw runtime artifact, peer address, absolute host path, parent environment, secret, port or datadir enters the generated evidence.
No deterministic-build, operator-binary, current-tip, full-history, sustained-operation or mainnet-coexistence claim.

files.test_reachability: Validates the reproduction driver on every governed change and exposes an explicit fresh-runner mainnet smoke dispatch.

files.production_reachability: None; public evidence reconstruction and validation only.
files.test_reachability: Builds exact fresh sources, verifies governed signatures, runs the immutable passive smoke, and emits two bounded JSON artifacts.

commands: Fresh-clone and build exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 in the existing digest-pinned Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 environment.
expected_results: The source is clean at the exact baseline commit and tree and its executable identity is recorded independently.

commands: Fresh-clone and build exact signed ERGON-CHANGE-0016 commit 7123fb262ab7a6b0a81981d06df627d58fa3ab1b in a distinct root under the same environment.
expected_results: The source, parent, record, runner and SSH signature identities match the governed target and the executable identity is recorded independently.

scenarios.command: Run the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0016 bounded passive mainnet-prefix smoke with fresh baseline and candidate builds.
expected_results: The candidate receives the same immutable checkpoint-288 prefix only from the loopback baseline, both roles restart cleanly, and two sanitized artifacts are emitted after cleanup.
failure_conditions: Any source, signature, build, topology, checkpoint, privacy, bound, cleanup or artifact-set mismatch fails closed; incomplete public acquisition remains inconclusive.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted legacy-mining-baseline regression gate against the exact fresh baseline build.
expected_results: The accepted baseline mining fixture still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, cache escape or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted legacy-mining-candidate regression gate against the exact fresh candidate build.
expected_results: The accepted candidate mining fixture still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, cache escape or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Rerun the unchanged accepted inherited default-launch regression gate against the exact fresh candidate build.
expected_results: The inherited selection still passes without skip or source mutation.
failure_conditions: Any selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source mutation, cache escape or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 virtual machine with mutable image identity recorded but excluded from deterministic-build claims
Digest-pinned Ubuntu 22.04 linux/arm64 container with packages resolved from the signed 20260901T000000Z Ubuntu archive snapshot

limitations: A successful dispatch would cover only one bounded historical prefix through checkpoint 288 and one legacy-to-candidate loopback transfer path.
The smoke does not reach current tip and does not establish full history, sustained operation, public candidate peering, operator-binary parity, deterministic builds or complete mainnet coexistence.
The fresh hosted runner image remains mutable even though the container and direct dependencies are locked and recorded.
This packet adds reproduction tooling only; it does not change the technical node candidate or promote evidence by itself.
counterevidence: No hosted run of this exact public reproduction workflow exists at record-review time.
The local ERGON-CHANGE-0016 run used distinct-inode copies of one legacy executable and therefore did not establish source-to-binary candidate independence.
The reproduced synthetic regtest matrix in ERGON-CHANGE-0015 does not answer passive public-network acquisition or mainnet-prefix transfer.
